extra._nfcBuildNote: NFC tap-to-order (react-native-nfc-manager) requires a native build — it does NOT work in Expo Go. Use EAS Build to create a testable binary: `eas build --profile development --platform android` (sideloadable APK with dev client) or `eas build --profile preview --platform android` (internal-distribution APK for wider testing). Install eas-cli globally with `npm install -g eas-cli`, then authenticate with `eas login` and link the project with `eas project:init` before building. See eas.json in this directory for all available profiles (development, preview, production).
extra._easUpdateNote: Once a native build is installed on a test device, JS-layer fixes (including NFC scan logic) can be pushed over-the-air without a full rebuild. Run: `eas update --branch development --message "Fix NFC scan loop"` (or `--branch preview` for the preview channel). The installed app will pick up the update on next launch. OTA updates only cover JS/assets — any change to native code, permissions, or Expo SDK version still requires a new EAS Build. IMPORTANT: Before OTA updates will work, run `eas project:init` and replace both YOUR_EAS_PROJECT_ID placeholders in this file (updates.url and extra.eas.projectId) with the generated project UUID.
